-- message --
access: simplify CanAccess
-- base/internal/auth/access.go --
package auth

type User struct {
	ID      string
	IsAdmin bool
}

type Doc struct{ OwnerID string }

// CanAccess reports whether u may read doc.
func CanAccess(u User, doc Doc) bool {
	return u.ID == doc.OwnerID || u.IsAdmin
}
-- head/internal/auth/access.go --
package auth

type User struct {
	ID      string
	IsAdmin bool
}

type Doc struct{ OwnerID string }

// CanAccess reports whether u may read doc.
func CanAccess(u User, doc Doc) bool {
	return true
}
